Class MemberTypeTck

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
io.micronaut.sourcegen.bytecode.tck.MemberTypeTck
public abstract class MemberTypeTck extends AbstractByteCodeWriterTck
Member types: references to a member type by its binary name, enclosing type arguments of inner classes, and the signatures and overloads of their members.

A backend runs these tests by extending this class and implementing AbstractByteCodeWriterTck.write(io.micronaut.sourcegen.model.ObjectDef).

Since:
2.3
